s1.syndrome_frame: Subacute onset of painful swelling and muscle weakness with systemic inflammation and multi-organ involvement
salient_findings: Painful swelling of the calves
Elevated muscle enzymes (CK, LDH)
Diffuse subcutaneous edema on CT scan
Muscle biopsy showing interstitial and perivascular infiltrates with necrosis and regeneration
Cardiac involvement with myocarditis and arrhythmias
Neurologic findings with myelitis and encephalitis
key_facts: 57-year-old man with history of mantle cell lymphoma in complete remission
Presented with painful swelling of the calves in August 2018
No evidence of deep venous thrombosis or soft-tissue infection
Brief gastroenteritis episode at the time of presentation
Diuretics provided transient relief
Systemic steroids and discontinuation of ibrutinib had no effect
Elevated LDH and CK on laboratory tests
Negative autoimmune serology
CT scan showed no lymphoma relapse but diffuse subcutaneous edema
ECOG performance status 3 at the time of hospitalization
Massive edema and extreme muscle tenderness
Weak symmetric fist closure and shoulder lift on neurologic exam
Elevated CRP, transaminases, and troponin I on laboratory tests
Reduced plasma protein, albumin, and IgG
Elevated leukocyte count
MRI of the thighs showed diffuse intramuscular and extramuscular edema
Muscle biopsy demonstrated interstitial and perivascular T-cell and macrophage infiltrates
Acute kidney injury secondary to rhabdomyolysis
Cardiac MRI confirmed myocarditis
Spinal MRI demonstrated a hyperintense lesion concerning for myelitis
CSF analysis showed elevated leukocyte count, lactate, and protein

shortlist.label: Dermatomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: Subacute onset of painful swelling and muscle weakness with systemic inflammation

shortlist.label: Polymyositis
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated CK and LDH, muscle biopsy demonstrating interstitial and perivascular T-cell and macrophage infiltrates

shortlist.label: Necrotizing autoimmune myopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated CK, muscle weakness, and necrosis on muscle biopsy

shortlist.label: Ibrutinib-induced myositis
shortlist.why_kept: Recent use of ibrutinib and development of myositis symptoms

shortlist.label: Lymphoma-associated myositis
shortlist.why_kept: History of mantle cell lymphoma and development of myositis symptoms

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms began after receiving ibrutinib, and the condition worsened despite discontinuation of the drug, suggesting a potential link between ibrutinib and the development of myositis

rejected.label: Dermatomyositis
rejected.why: The patient did not exhibit characteristic skin manifestations of dermatomyositis

rejected.label: Polymyositis
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms and laboratory results are more consistent with a drug-induced myositis rather than a primary inflammatory myopathy

rejected.label: Necrotizing autoimmune myopathy
rejected.why: While the patient had elevated CK and muscle biopsy showed necrosis, the temporal association with ibrutinib initiation is more suggestive of a drug-induced cause

rejected.label: Lymphoma-associated myositis
rejected.why: The patient was in complete remission from mantle cell lymphoma, making it less likely that the myositis is directly related to the lymphoma
